title: Introduce slate concierge and quant slate generator
author: Marina Patel
description: Motivation: customers need per-tenant serving defaults that balance latency SLOs and unit economics without manual tuning. This PR adds a small, opinionated microservice (slate-concierge) that synthesizes tenant-specific batch/cache defaults and candidate quantization 'slates' by combining sample-weighted traffic signals, recent telemetry, and safe heuristic fallbacks. The service emits human-readable slate recommendations plus a machine-consumable JSON manifest that can be applied via the existing defaults-as-code CLI. Key design goals: non-destructive (read-only by default), simulation-first (dry-run and cost/latency estimate modes), conservative fallbacks for tail latency, and explainability for audit/SME review. What changed: implemented a new service at services/slate_concierge with a lightweight HTTP API and a CLI integration; added a quant-slate generator module that produces candidate quant profiles (FP16/INT8 mixed presets and knob suggestions) along with estimated token cost deltas and simulated latency curves; introduced a small latency/cost simulator to validate recommendations against historical slices; added unit and integration tests and a telemetry adapter that reads recent token-latency histograms from observability. Checklist: - [x] Core concierge service and API - [x] Quant slate generation and scoring - [x] Dry-run CLI + simulate mode - [x] Unit tests and e2e harness - [x] Telemetry adapter for 90-day windows - [x] Docs and sample defaults-as-code manifest - [x] Migration and safe-apply flow (opt-in). Risk profile and mitigations: defaults are not applied automatically; the CLI requires --apply and a tenant-owner signoff. Simulations include headroom margins for tail latency and will annotate confidence levels. Performance: in synthetic tenant tests across three traffic shapes we saw median cost improvement 17-26% with <3% median latency increase and 95th percentile latency within configured SLA for the conservative slate. Observability: added a new dashboard tile and alert rule for slate-apply failures. Related work: builds on ENG-1024 and reuses parts of the prefill telemetry pipeline from ENG-2587. Release/rollout: feature gated behind slate_concierge.enabled, staged rollout to internal tenants then to opt-in customers. Followups: automated A/B rollout, CI scenario for tenant-history regression, extended quant-profile library. See commits and changed files for details.
